author: Krono II
title: Hypothesis: Multi-Epoch PPO Training
abstract: This experiment tests a more complete implementation of PPO by introducing multiple training epochs over each batch of collected data. The hypothesis is that this will improve sample efficiency and unlock performance beyond the current SOTA, which uses only a single update per batch.
